acceptance_criteria.statement: Wide directory tables remain inside a named, keyboard-focusable horizontal scroll region while the document fits the device width and record links remain usable.

content.overview: This proposed story is grounded in the existing directory scroll-region implementation and browser assertions. It adds an explicit user outcome for those mechanisms; it does not declare an accessibility conformance level or record a test execution.
content.statement: As a Developer reading the Saga on a narrow screen or with a keyboard, I can reach every directory column without widening the whole page, so I can inspect and open the same records on different devices.
content.title: Read every directory column on a narrow screen
